appearance.identity: Martorell unequal Gothic arches with summit shelter and Roman gateway.
appearance.exclusions: Modern road/rail bridges, individual archaeological blocks and conservation survey.

brief: Compact Pont del Diable: open unequal arches, pointed/rounded cutwaters, graded stair walk, actual shelter passage, surviving Roman gateway and representative copper crown. Detailed master independently preserved.

elevationEvidence.attribution: Derived from elevation data of the Institut Cartogràfic i Geològic de Catalunya (ICGC), CC BY 4.0.
